Separate IndexedDB store within ThoughtPartnerDB State-based capture extends thought partner state machine LLM task selection for fuzzy matching Auto-pause on conflict when starting new task start task [description] - Create + begin work (auto-pauses current if exists) log task [description] end - Create in paused state without starting work pause task - Pause current resume task - Resume most recently paused complete task - Complete current cancel task - Cancel current switch to task [description] - LLM finds existing or creates new, switches to it how long - Report current session duration log task vs start task: `log task` → creates paused task (for later) `start task` → creates active task (work begins now) Resume logic: Find tasks where status='paused', sort by most recent session.end DESC, return first Switch task: LLM searches existing tasks If found → pause current, start selected If not found → pause current, create + start new Always succeeds with TTS confirmation Auto-pause: When `start task` called with active currentTask → pause current first Task handlers MUST come before thought partner handlers to prevent trigger conflicts. start: "Starting [name]" or "Pausing [old], starting [new]" pause: "Pausing [name]" resume: "Resuming [name]" complete: "Completed [name]" cancel: "Cancelled [name]" switch: "Switching to [name]" duration: "[X] minutes" System: "You help select tasks from a list based on user descriptions." Query: User query + numbered task list + "Return JSON: {taskNumber: N or null}" Call: `inference.prompt` with `responseFormat: { type: 'json_object' }` Fallback: If LLM fails/returns null → treat as "not found" → create new task indexed-db (persistence) inference (task selection) tts (confirmations) web-speech-stt (voice input)
